24/7 standby lane

Service

When the story is already moving, you have one hour.

The first statement sets the frame for everything that follows. Our crisis lane exists so that a considered, verified holding statement is published before the second wave of coverage, not after it.

Set up a crisis laneEditorial standards
Quick answer The PressCosmos crisis lane publishes an approved statement in under 60 minutes, at any hour, through a 24/7 standby editor. It includes holding statement templates, coordinated multi-region rollout, monitoring with negative-sentiment triggers, and verified correction distribution when facts change.

The lane

What happens when you trigger it

T-0 · Trigger

You call the crisis number, page the standby editor and confirm the facts you can stand behind.

T+20 min · Draft

A holding statement is drafted from your pre-approved templates and legal guardrails.

T+45 min · Approval

One named approver signs off. Compressed approval chain, not a committee.

T+60 min · Publish

Statement goes live across your selected regions with monitoring alerts armed.

Preparation

The work that happens before you need it

Holding statement library

Six pre-drafted, pre-approved statement shapes covering the most common crisis categories, ready to adapt in minutes.

Named approvers

A documented approval chain with after-hours contacts, so nobody spends twenty minutes working out who can authorise.

Trigger thresholds

Negative-sentiment and volume thresholds that page you automatically rather than waiting for someone to notice.

Legal guardrails

Pre-agreed language on litigation, disclosure and regulated industries so a statement never creates a second problem.

Corrections handled properly If facts change after publication, we distribute a labelled correction with the original text retained. Quiet edits are how organisations lose credibility twice for the same incident.

Get started

Set the lane up before you need it.

Crisis lane access is included on Newsmaker and Studio plans, and available as a standalone retainer.

Talk to a crisis lead See pricing

No subscription required · Cancel anytime · Human editorial review on every release
